items.title: Tesla prepares for Cybercab launch in August starting with rides to employees, the Information reports
items.summary: Tesla has told employees it is gearing up for a public launch ‌of Cybercab, starting with a rollout in ‌Austin, Texas, as soon as this month, the Information reported on ​Monday, citing people with knowledge of the plans.  Cybercab, a purpose-built autonomous vehicle without pedals or a steering wheel, is crucial to Tesla's robotaxi ambitions, as ‌the company is planning ⁠to eventually deploy the vehicle for its autonomous ride-hailing service.  • Tesla has told staff that it plans to begin the Cybercab rollout by ​offering rides ​to its employees on ​public roads and then ‌incorporate Cybercabs into its robotaxi service in Austin a few days later, according to the report.

items.title: Tesla to launch Cybercab in Austin this month - report
items.summary: Investing.com -- Tesla Inc. has informed staff it is preparing for a public launch of the Cybercab, its first vehicle built without a steering wheel or brake pedal, in Austin, Texas, as soon as this month, The Information reported on Monday.
